progdir=base/'programs'; progdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
p=progdir/'task-3b543c4f.py'
src='''def transform(grid):\n    """Move every non-background cell one row down, clipping at the bottom."""\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))\n    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid):\n        for c, value in enumerate(row):\n            if value != bg and r + 1 < h:\n                out[r + 1][c] = value\n    return out\n'''
